title: BeginRequest
description: The choice the owner took on the start card of the workflow rounds, the branches an earlier run left, and the integration branch.

choice.description: build or build-without-interface goes on to cut the slice's worktree; build-over or build-over-without-interface drops the earlier run's branches first; stop ends the run before anything is cut.

leftovers.description: Each branch an earlier run left that may hold work, with the commit it points at; empty when there is none.

branch.description: The branch an earlier run left.

commit.description: The commit it points at, in full.

into.description: The integration branch, named as into on every drop so it is never dropped.
